issue.title: Task theme suggestions: suggest, explain, remember
issue.description: Every task-aware Pomodoro menu preselects the theme a task most likely belongs to, says why in the same words on every surface, and remembers deliberate exceptions as a `[theme:: X]` field on the task line. One Rust-owned rule drives bob-cli, the Obsidian plugins mirror it under shared vectors, and Bob Mac Capture renders bob's JSON.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/task_theme_suggestions.md requests this work

issue.title: bob-cli suggestion rule, task field, and `bob themes suggest`
issue.description: suggest-core: Rust owns the rule. Parse `theme:` note defaults and `[theme:: X]` task fields, resolve the suggestion and inherited theme, implement the canonical field writer and the write rule as pure functions, add `plan.reading_theme`, ship read-only `bob themes suggest` and the `theme_default_unknown` hint, extend the shared vectors, write PT12 and the vault-format rows, and add the memory records.

issue.title: Theme rename covers note defaults and task fields
